info.title: pix-psp-simulator
info.description: Local sandbox that simulates a Pix PSP, the SPI and the DICT for offline integration testing. Simplified models; not affiliated with the Banco Central do Brasil; not for production.

put.summary: Block, close or reactivate an account
put.description: Payments to BLOCKED accounts are rejected with AC06 and to CLOSED accounts with AC04.

get.summary: List the DICT keys of an account

key.description: CPF, CNPJ (numeric or alphanumeric), e-mail, +55 phone or EVP. Normalized with brpay.

evp.description: With an empty key, generate a random EVP key.

get.summary: Look a key up (rate limited per payer)
get.description: Owner document is masked as PSP apps show it. Each payer has a token bucket; lookups of missing keys cost extra tokens. Limits are illustrative, not the BCB's.

post.summary: Open an ownership or portability claim
Confirm, cancel or complete a claim

account_id.description: Acting account: donor confirms, claimer completes, either cancels.

post.summary: Create a static or dynamic charge (BR Code)

get.description: The URL embedded in dynamic BR Codes. Returned as plain JSON; real PSPs serve a signed JWS.

post.description: Settles asynchronously after the configured latency. Business failures do not fail the call: the transfer ends RJCT with an ISO reason code and a pix.rejected webhook.

post.summary: Pay a BR Code (copia e cola)
post.description: The code is linted with brpay; lint errors are returned in the problem's issues array.

post.summary: Move an infraction through the MED state machine
post.description: OPEN -block-> BLOCKED -analyze-> ANALYSIS -accept-> REFUNDED | -reject-> CLOSED; OPEN or BLOCKED -cancel-> CANCELLED. Simplified model.

post.summary: Time travel: move the clock forward
post.description: Pending settlements and webhook retries whose time has come run immediately; charges and claims expire on their next read.

post.summary: Load a scenario (same format as scenarios/*.json)

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Filter by reference (EndToEndId, refund id, infraction id).

post.summary: Event delivered to the account webhook

200.description: Any 2xx acknowledges; anything else is retried with exponential backoff and jitter.

TransferRequest.description: Set exactly one of key, to_account_id or to_account.

WebhookEvent.description: Body of every webhook delivery. Signed with X-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, t + '.' + body)>.

data.description: A Transfer, or a Refund for refund.completed.

Key.name: key
Key.description: Pix key; URL-encode CNPJ slashes or use the clean form.

XPayerId.name: X-Payer-Id
XPayerId.description: Identity used for DICT rate limiting (defaults to anonymous).

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Retries with the same key and body return the original transfer (200, Idempotent-Replayed: true) for 24h.

XSimFail.name: X-Sim-Fail
XSimFail.description: Reject with this ISO reason code.

XSimTimeout.name: X-Sim-Timeout
XSimTimeout.description: true rejects with AB03 after the latency.

XSimWebhookDuplicates.name: X-Sim-Webhook-Duplicates
XSimWebhookDuplicates.description: Extra copies of each resulting webhook (same event id).

XSimWebhookReorder.name: X-Sim-Webhook-Reorder
XSimWebhookReorder.description: Random extra delay up to this duration per delivery.

Unprocessable.description: Semantically invalid; BR Code lint errors are listed in issues
